system.roleplaying: You hear a voice in your head that no one else hears. That voice tells you things, which might be true or false, but the voice certainly seems to know a lot.
system.minorTwist: How did the voice in your head just distract you?
system.majorTwist: What is the voice demanding of you now?

greenAbility.name: Principle of Whispers
greenAbility.gameText: Overcome against a challenge that involves information that you have no real way of knowing and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
